title: Two named party members join through multi-line notifications
action: accept party invitations while monitoring an existing party

sensitivityHandling.notes: Member handles, marker IDs, and tracked entity IDs are synthetic. Marker evidence is retained only as corroboration.

expectedNonEvents.reason: Party marker stream-in alone must not create a named member.

correlation.notes: Notification identity is authoritative for the named join; marker IDs are not mapped to handles.

knownLimitations: This fixture proves named joins but not disconnect, kick, leader change, or disband semantics.
verificationNotes: Whole-file and one-byte split parsing must emit exactly two PartyMemberJoined events with stable event IDs.
